   Auto-compact window
   Current setting for Haiku 5.5: 400k tokens (from settings)

   This command configures when auto-compaction happens. The actual threshold is the minimum of this setting and your
   model's maximum context window.

   The auto setting picks a window tuned for your model and is strongly recommended for the best cost and
   performance. You can override it below.

   Select auto-compact window: 400k tokens

   ←/→ to adjust · Enter to apply · Esc to cancel
